title: Golden solution fails its own verifier (score 0.0, 167 cell errors) due to un-recalculated Excel iterative cache vs. LibreOffice recalculation of output
evidence: In `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (`verifiers/spreadsheetbench2.py:362-369`), only `output_path` is recalculated in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`), while `reference_path` (`untouched_input_Unit Mismatch_input.xlsx`) and `gt_path` (`gt_10_golden.xlsx`) are loaded directly from their Excel-saved cached values. Both workbooks have iterative calculation enabled (`iterate="true"`, `iterateCount="100"`, `iterateDelta="0.0001"` in `xl/workbook.xml`) and contain a circular debt/cash-sweep/interest loop on `Model` rows 121-199 (`I121 = -SUM(-I183,I197,I199:I200,I207)`, `I181 = I146+I194+I195+I205`, `I195 = IF($H201=0,0,MIN(MAX((-I193+-I194),-(I146+I194+(I$182-$K$11))),0))`). None of the 9 actual formula/value edits between input and golden (`Model!D16`, `Model!F218`, `P&L Summary!B48:B50`, `P&L Summary!E48:E50`, `FY24SAIL15!R10`) feed into `Model!I121:M199`, yet `untouched_input` and `gt_10_golden` were saved in Excel at different iterative states (e.g., `Model!I195` is cached as `0` in input vs. `-3.072701` in golden; `Model!I182` is `2.873958` in input vs. `-0.111997` in golden),and `4-Wall Analysis!AR867, AR939, BE1083, BE1155` differ by `1e-16` float noise that fails relative tolerance. Worse, when `gt_10_golden.xlsx` itself is graded by `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight 1.0), LibreOffice recalculation converges to a different fixed point (`Model!I121 = -3.087776` vs. golden cached `-3.004062`; `Model!I181 = 1.049212` vs. `-1.111997`), causing the golden workbook itself to score `0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.4339. 167 cell error(s)`).
confirmation: Confirmed locally: the recalculated golden converges to different values on the circular debt/cash-sweep block (Model!I121 -3.0878 vs cached -3.0041, I122 -6.108 vs -6.024), and the golden fails its own verifier with modification 0.4339.
fix: verifications[0].parameters.answer_position: carved out of the graded ranges the blocks driven by the workbook's iterative (circular) debt/cash-sweep loop, whose values LibreOffice's forced recalc does not converge to the same point twice: Model!I121:M199, R20:T41, X20:X41, AL20:AN41, AW20:AW41; 'P&L Summary'!R7:T8, G40:K41; '4-Wall Analysis'!BS5:DD17 (1,081 of 294,669 cells; all 266 cells that differed across repeated recalcs are inside). The 9 real edits (Model D16, F218, P&L Summary B48:B50/E48:E50, FY24SAIL15 R10) and their dependents are still graded. Local checks with the verifier's score_workbooks: golden PASS (was 0.0, mod 0.4339); input + the 9 golden edits PASS; untouched input still FAILS (mod 0.035). graderGuidance range list updated to match.

title: Golden workbook fails the verifier's mandatory recalculation
evidence: The verifier recalculates the submitted workbook but compares it against unrecalculated golden caches. Applying that same recalculation to gt_10_golden.xlsx and running the official score_workbooks function returns regression 1.0000, modification 0.4339, and 167 modification errors. For example, Model!I195 has a cached value of -3.0727010080648, although evaluating its formula using the golden workbook's own cached inputs gives -0.848706578757467; forced recalculation produces -0.848706268009615. Model!I121 likewise recalculates to -3.08777611992694 instead of the expected -3.00406239978358. Because every modification cell must match, the golden workbook itself earns zero on the sole verifier, which has weight 1. This makes stale calculation state part of the answer key and penalizes correctly recalculated deliverables.

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells is a trivial fail (cannot pass even on the ground-truth golden workbook)
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) scored 0.0 (`unit 1`: mod 0.2712, 231 errors; `unit 2`: mod 0.2576, 222 errors; `unit 3`: mod 0.2576, 243 errors). While all 3 agent attempts also missed `Model!F218` (and units 2 and 3 missed `Model!D16`), the verifier itself is fundamentally broken and cannot return 1.0 even on a perfect submission. Specifically, `untouched_input_Unit Mismatch_input.xlsx` and `gt_10_golden.xlsx` have different saved iterative-calculation states in `Model!I121:M199` (178 cells in `Model`, `P&L Summary`, and `4-Wall Analysis` that have identical formulas and zero dependency on the 9 actual edits between input and golden), and `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` recalculates ONLY `output_path` in LibreOffice while comparing against the un-recalculated cached values in `gt_10_golden.xlsx`. Because LibreOffice's iterative calculation of `gt_10_golden.xlsx` converges to different values than Excel's saved cache in `gt_10_golden.xlsx`, passing `gt_10_golden.xlsx` itself as `output_path` yields `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.4339. 167 cell error(s)`).
confirmation: Grading gt_10_golden.xlsx against itself through the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalculation locally gives regression 1.0 and modification 0.4339 (for example Model!I121 answer -3.00406 vs recalculated -3.08778). The stale Excel iterative cache in the golden makes the task unpassable.
